current_invocation.deadline_enforcement: Process ITIMER_REAL includes module loading; inherited budget time_cap text describes the producer executor, not this readonly consumer.
current_invocation.memory_enforcement: Budget RSS samples between admission steps, not a continuous watchdog; process_peak_rss_bytes is the OS process high-water mark.

budget_before.accounting: q live cap; cumulative allocation/mapped-write/action costs never credited back; measured unlinks only; header/reservation slack retained; logical writes, not physical device I/O
budget_before.memory_accounting: parent plus child RSS; shared pages conservatively counted repeatedly
budget_before.time_cap: parent watchdog at 0.1 second intervals; native calls may be terminated

budget_after.accounting: q live cap; cumulative allocation/mapped-write/action costs never credited back; measured unlinks only; header/reservation slack retained; logical writes, not physical device I/O
budget_after.memory_accounting: parent plus child RSS; shared pages conservatively counted repeatedly

accounting: Actual QBudget/action snapshots for readonly admission; existing target logical bytes charged, final report publication excluded. Original worker fields and numeric types retained verbatim as historical provenance, never current costs. Hash/read/device-I/O counts are not instrumented.
storage: Hardlinks, not copies; each surviving cache/adoption alias pins physical storage after producer retirement. Logical retired bytes are not physical reclaimed bytes while any alias survives.
